items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Then in September of that year, you recorded with Oliver Mesheux... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. That was a pick-up group for recording.

ctx.x: Yeah. It's got Max Kaminsky on that one.

Right, that's a trio. I think I sent you some of that on the tape. That was in April. Then in September of that year, you recorded with Oliver Mesheux, the trumpet player, and Omer Simeon on clarinet, and Pops Foster on bass, with Art Hodes.
